author: reek
body: Positive guard for capability stages 1a and 1b: app-quire functions that perform device I/O and honestly declare the Device.* effect type-check. These are the sanctioned counterparts to errors/cap-launder-pure-io, errors/cap-launder-pure-block, and errors/cap-launder-pure-mmio - each effect is real and declarable, not a blanket ban. read-port declares Device.Port, read-sector0 declares Device.Block, mmio-byte declares Device.Mmio, so the row-subset check passes on all three; the naked calls without the declarations are the error cases. opening stays pure and calls none of them, so the run is deterministic.
